mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates stronger economic fundamentals that support corporate earnings growth and reduce equity risk premiums, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where GDPC1 exceeds its 5-year rolling median, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong real GDP (GDPC1) and very low interest rates (FEDFUNDS) indicates a robust economic recovery supported by aggressive monetary policy, which significantly boosts equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for GDPC1 * FEDFUNDS interaction falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances where GDPC1 > 5-year median and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During early labor market downturns characterized by rising unemployment (UNRATE), economic uncertainty increases and corporate earnings expectations decline, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100,000 monthly additions signals severe labor market deterioration that typically precedes stock market corrections, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS < 100000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing slowdowns characterized by declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as supply chain disruptions and weak manufacturing activity signal broader economic weakness, producing negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher rate of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates strengthening economic activity that may trigger monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds its 5-year rolling median, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates severe economic contraction that triggers heightened equity risk aversion, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for PAYEMS * INDPRO interaction falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS < 100000 and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months.
